marbles_balance_challenge_v0.1.0.description:
Initial release of the *Marbles! Balance Challenge* Archipelago.

This release adds *Marbles! Balance Challenge* as a playable Archipelago world with:
- Support for all ingame difficulties (Easy, Normal, Hard)
- Random Starting World and Starting Marble
- World unlocks
- Level goal checks
- Kororin Capsule checks
- Green Gems checks
- Trophy checks
- 4 different Traps

...and much more (see full list in [Marbles Balance Challenge Game Info](worlds/marbles_balance_challenge/docs/en_Marbles!%20Balance%20Challenge.md))

Requires Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer, Dolphin Emulator, and the **PAL** version of Marbles! Balance Challenge (`RK6P18`).
(see [Setup Guide](worlds/marbles_balance_challenge/docs/setup_en.md) for how to play)

I've tested the apworld extensively and it should be ready for APs with your friends.
But still be cautious, there can be little things that I might've not noticed while testing.
If you do find bugs or have suggestions for this AP, make sure to join the official Archipelago Discord server and tell me your regards in the Marbles! Balance Challenge thread under Future Game Design.
